tools.name: invoke
tools.description: Do what the user asks using a verified API on Teetra. Starts as a free trial; results come back as data.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Find matching APIs and actions for what the user wants to do without running them. Optionally filter by domain. Read-only.

tools.name: confirm
tools.description: Preview and approve a pending action by its pending_id. Used when a write requires user confirmation before running.

tools.name: authorize
tools.description: Connect your own account or API key for a service to continue past the free trial. Accepts an API key or token, or delivers a sign-in link.

tools.name: account
tools.description: Check your remaining free trial calls or subscription allowance across services. Read-only.
